$$
V=\text{Span}\{[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -1 \\ 1\end{aligned}],[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 3 \\ -3\end{aligned}]\},\,B=\{[\begin{aligned}\frac{\sqrt{6}}{3} \\ -\frac{\sqrt{6}}{6} \\ \frac{\sqrt{6}}{6}\end{aligned}],[\begin{aligned}a \\ b \\ c\end{aligned}]\}
$$

Consider the subspace $V$ and an **orthonormal** basis $B$ of $V,$ given above. Given that $B$ is derived from $V$ using the Gram-Schmidt process, what is the value of $|a|+|b|+|c|?$

First, let's denote

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14157663/assets/98ad0679a59d17aa0025dbf5d713513dd310715c87b670c98245982f53507367.svg)

We proceed to find an orthogonal basis using the Gram-Schmidt process, as follows.

- **Step 1**: We set ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14157663/assets/9ae9a423546f781540431c9f90841610d0c6e200c949c044d0e1d311e057144a.svg)

- **Step 2**: Next, we find $\mathbf{v}_2$, by using the formula

$$
\begin{aligned}{v}_{2} & ={a}_{2}-\frac{{a}_{2}\cdot {v}_{1}}{{v}_{1}\cdot {v}_{1}}{v}_{1}.\end{aligned}
$$

Applying the formula for $\mathbf v_2$ in our case gives

$$
\begin{aligned} & ={a}_{2}-\frac{6\cdot 2+0\cdot 2+3\cdot (-1)}{{2}^{2}+{2}^{2}+(-1)^{2}}{v}_{1} \\  & =[\begin{aligned}6 \\ 0 \\ 3\end{aligned}]-[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 2 \\ -1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}4 \\ -2 \\ 4\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we normalize each vector to get an orthonormal basis:

- ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14157663/assets/628a9aaa7bd54fe4489ee771adaa9f354b8189c1b763e4d139ad32b371423973.svg)

- ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14157663/assets/d2283ef21e153d2a966c2f28e1bb0b6008bfa9430319824865e4f7f3e4e20bb8.svg)

Therefore, ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14157663/assets/263a9ec8bae347b4b4b92280c1685d39a23a488cc4a9f03a15e87921c7df4604.svg) is an orthonormal basis for $V.$

Finally, $a=\dfrac{2}{3},$ $b=-\dfrac1  3,$ $c=\dfrac{2}{3},$ and  

$$
|a|+|b|+|c| = \left| \dfrac{2}{3} \right| + \left|-\dfrac{1}{3}\right| + \left| \dfrac{2}{3} \right| = \dfrac 5 3.
$$
